Combat Expertise.name: Combat Expertise: -[[1+floor(@attributes.bab.total/4)]] melee attack & CMB for +[[1+floor(@attributes.bab.total/4)]] dodge AC

Dramatic Display.name: Dramatic Display: +[[2]] CMB until end of next turn

Drunken Brawler.name: Drunken Brawler (drunk): +[[2]] alchemical Fort & Will, -[[2]] Reflex

Improved Back to Back.name: Improved Back to Back: +2 AC vs flankers [[2]]

Multiweapon Defense.name: Multiweapon Defense: forgo off-hand attacks for +[[1]] each (max +5) shield bonus to AC

Reward of Grace.name: Reward of Grace: lay on hands used this round

Risky Striker.name: Risky Striker: -[[1]] AC (vs creatures 2+ sizes larger only)

Savage Display.name: Savage Display: performance combat check made (until end of next turn)

Shield of Swings.name: Shield of Swings: full-attack with a two-handed weapon, reduce your weapon damage by [[1/2]] to gain a +[[4]] shield bonus to AC and a +[[4]] shield bonus to CMD until your next turn

Unsanctioned Detection.name: Unsanctioned Detection: +10 sacred Perception & Sense Motive (1 rd, expends detect evil 24h)

Demon Hunter.name: Demon Hunter (vs demons): +2 morale on attack rolls

Ferocious Loyalty.name: Ferocious Loyalty: +1 morale on attack rolls vs a foe threatening an ally who also has this feat (+2 morale for 1 min if such an ally is downed/killed within 30 ft)

Bloody Vengeance.name: Bloody Vengeance: vs a studied foe that has damaged you within the last minute, your melee hits deal +[[1]] bleed damage

Bear Hug.name: Bear Hug: +2 bonus on damage rolls against foes you are grappling.

Bloodstone Manhunter.name: Bloodstone Manhunter: +1 on weapon attack and damage rolls and on Bluff/Knowledge/Perception/Sense Motive/Survival checks against humans (does not stack with a favored enemy bonus vs humans).

Champion.name: Champion: Swift action to declare single combat on one foe within 50 ft: +1 on attack rolls and +1 dodge AC against that foe (only while no one else threatens it). If another combatant attacks you or that foe, the challenge ends and you tak

Charging Hurler.name: Charging Hurler: When making a thrown-weapon attack as a charge (end movement within 30 ft of the target): +2 on the attack roll and -2 to AC until the start of your next turn.

Cold Celerity.name: Cold Celerity: In severe cold (below 0F), or for 1 round after taking cold damage: +1 on attack rolls.

Death from Above.name: Death from Above: When you charge an opponent from higher ground, or from above while flying: +5 on attack rolls (in place of the charge and higher-ground bonuses).

Deathless Initiate.name: Deathless Initiate: While using the Diehard feat (i.e. at 0 or fewer hit points): +2 on melee attack rolls and +2 on melee damage rolls.

Demonic Nemesis.name: Demonic Nemesis: Against followers of your chosen demon lord (cultists or demons): +2 on damage rolls and on rolls to confirm critical hits.

Desperate Battler.name: Desperate Battler: When no ally is within 10 feet and you are not benefiting from aid another: +1 morale bonus on melee attack rolls and +1 morale bonus on melee damage rolls.

Disorienting Maneuver.name: Disorienting Maneuver: After tumbling through an opponent's space with Acrobatics, +2 circumstance on attack rolls vs that opponent (and +4 circumstance on a trip CMB) until your next turn.

Dog Killer, Horse Hunter.name: Dog Killer, Horse Hunter: +2 morale on all attack rolls against dogs and horses (and doglike/horselike creatures such as nightmares or worgs); also +2 to confirm crits vs them. +2 morale on all damage rolls against dogs and horses (and dogl

Dog-Sniff-Hate.name: Dog-Sniff-Hate: Against canines (dogs, goblin dogs, wolves, worgs, yeth hounds, etc.): +1 morale on attack rolls. Against canines (dogs, goblin dogs, wolves, worgs, yeth hounds, etc.): +2 morale on weapon damage rolls.

Exploit Lore.name: Exploit Lore: Once/day after a successful Knowledge check identifying a creature, +2 on attack rolls against that creature for 1 minute. Once/day after a successful Knowledge check identifying a creature, +2 on damage rolls against that cre

Fire Hand.name: Fire Hand: +1 on attack rolls with melee weapons that deal fire damage (e.g. a torch).

Focused Discipline.name: Focused Discipline: +2 morale on attack rolls, weapon damage, and CMB vs a creature whose fear effect you just resisted (1 round).

Giant Killer.name: Giant Killer: +2 circumstance on attack rolls for the extra cleave-style attacks made against humanoids (giant).

Gloom Strike.name: Gloom Strike: +1 on attack rolls against enemies in dim light or darkness, while you are also in dim light or darkness.

Gnome Weapon Focus.name: Gnome Weapon Focus: +1 on attack rolls with gnome weapons (weapons with 'gnome' in the name).

Goblin Cleaver.name: Goblin Cleaver: +2 circumstance on attack rolls for the extra Cleave/Great Cleave attacks made against humanoids (goblinoid).

Grudge Fighter.name: Grudge Fighter: +1 morale on attack and damage rolls against any creature that has attacked you in the current combat.

Halfling Slinger.name: Halfling Slinger: +1 racial bonus on attack rolls made using a sling.

Hard-Headed.name: Hard-Headed: +1 on attack rolls and combat maneuver checks made using a helmet (improvised weapon).

Horde Charge.name: Horde Charge: +2 on attack rolls when charging during the same round as an ally with this feat. +2 on damage rolls when charging during the same round as an ally with this feat (first attack only).

Improved Charging Hurler.name: Improved Charging Hurler: +2 on damage rolls when using Charging Hurler against a target within 30 feet.

Legacy of Ozem.name: Legacy of Ozem: +1 sacred bonus on weapon damage rolls when using good-aligned weapons (including those affected by bless weapon).

Liberator.name: Liberator: +1 bonus on attack rolls when your actions would directly lead to freeing prisoners or slaves. +1 bonus on weapon damage rolls when your actions would directly lead to freeing prisoners or slaves.

Mantis Wisdom.name: Mantis Wisdom: +2 bonus on unarmed attack rolls when using a Stunning Fist attempt while in Mantis Style.

Monkey Shine.name: Monkey Shine: +4 bonus on melee attack rolls against the opponent whose space you entered.

Moonlight Stalker.name: Moonlight Stalker: +2 bonus on attack rolls against an opponent you have concealment from. +2 bonus on damage rolls against an opponent you have concealment from.

Multiweapon Specialist.name: Multiweapon Specialist: +2 bonus on damage rolls when wielding a one-handed or light weapon in each arm with all weapons from the same fighter weapon group.

Net and Trident.name: Net and Trident: +2 bonus on damage rolls and on crit-confirmation attack rolls when attacking an entangled opponent with your light or one-handed melee weapon.

Nightmare Fist.name: Nightmare Fist: +2 bonus on damage rolls with unarmed strikes (or +4 vs shaken/frightened/panicked foes) while fighting within an area of magical darkness.

Orc Hewer.name: Orc Hewer: +2 circumstance bonus on attack rolls for Cleave/Great Cleave additional attacks against humanoids (orc).

Planar Hunter.name: Planar Hunter: +2 bonus on weapon attack rolls against outsiders native to a favored planar terrain (and identified extraplanar creatures from it); also ignore up to 5 points of DR against them.

Shamed.name: Shamed: +1 on attack rolls and skill checks while in a conflict observed by uninvolved others

Town Tamer.name: Town Tamer: In your chosen settlement: +1 on attack rolls and +2 on combat maneuver checks against undesirable elements (criminals/ruffians).

Twin Thunders Flurry.name: Twin Thunders Flurry: +2 on damage rolls against creatures of the giant subtype.

Vengeance.name: Vengeance: +1 on attack rolls against your chosen foe and its known minions. +1 on weapon damage rolls against your chosen foe and its known minions.
